name: Scholar Publications Fetcher
author: valsze

sections.description:
Automatically fetch and display your Scholar publications in a clean, responsive card layout—newest first—with optional abstract support.

A lightweight WordPress plugin that:

  • Highlights your latest publication with title, authors, journal, year, and abstract.
  • Displays the next four works in equally sized, responsive cards.
  • Includes a “Read More” button linking back to your Scholar profile.
  • Supports decorative vine ornaments or custom PNG background overlays.
  • Offers dark-mode & light-mode styling with customizable CSS.
  • Requires no API keys or external dependencies; uses core PHP DOM and WordPress HTTP API.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the scholar-publications-fetcher folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Scholar Publications Fetcher in the Plugins menu.

  3. Use the shortcode in any page or post:

    [schopufe_publications user_id="YOUR_SCHOLAR_ID"]

  4. (Optional) Customize the CSS in css/gs-styles.css or override via your theme.
sections.faq:
Can I display more publications?

Yes. By default the plugin shows 5 items (1 main + 4 cards). You can extend the secondary cards by filtering the shortcode behavior in your theme or via a custom attribute in a future update.

How do I change the design or colors?

Override or edit the css/gs-styles.css file in the plugin directory, or enqueue your own stylesheet in your child theme with higher specificity.

Do I need an API key?

No. The plugin scrapes your public Google Scholar page directly; no authentication or keys required.
